purpose: verify the frozen thresholds (derived from broker data/mt5_full) remain valid on the LIVE site feed (Yahoo GC=F futures, rebased to spot)
findings: Day-break STRUCTURE matches: both feeds show exactly one maintenance break per trading day with dt=1.08h -> the BUG-BRKTHRESH rule (diff>1800s) fires once per day on the live feed, zero false breaks.

No intraday false breaks: the live 5d window contains only 300s (1148), 600s (5), 270/330s (1 each) and 3900s (4) diffs. Only the 3900s ones exceed 1800s, and all 4 are the real daily maintenance break.
Gap SCALE matches: live weekday gaps observed at 1.80/-0.20/0.30/-0.60 USD sit in the same range as the broker weekday |gap| median of 0.470 USD.
Frozen thresholds reproduced exactly from the broker feed (weekday q80=1.010, weekend q80=2.952), confirming frozen_thresholds_M5.json.

rebaseFuturesToSpot subtracts a CONSTANT offset from every bar, and a gap is a DIFFERENCE -> the gap is invariant under rebasing (offset cancels). Futures-vs-spot level therefore cannot bias this layer.
verdict: CALIBRATION OK — the frozen broker-derived thresholds are valid on the live Yahoo feed; day-break detection is clean (1/day, no false positives).
caveat: The trade window is 5 minutes (maxHold=1 M5 bar). The site evaluates closed bars, so a live ENTRY is only surfaced during the single refresh cycle right after the new day's first bar closes; otherwise the layer reports NEUTRAL and states how many bars have passed.
